eliminated.model_instance: Megami served Roger bank data under the jun bank name stands at idle span 1.38 m in-game (vs 0.91 m with Jun data). Instance is fine; the Jun bank data is the defect.
eliminated.model_rig: Megami no-outfit GLB and Menajerii GLB: same 52 joints, same rest positions (Hips y 0.95, Head y 1.48). Jun clips produce identical retarget spans on both rigs. Not the cause.

fix: Four bank clips re-baked from the SAME source entries (no frames added, removed or altered; FK self-check 0.000000 m each): t3_neutral with the backward-anchored unwrap chain; t3_grab with the forward-anchored chain; t3_medium and t3_walk_back from the raw decoded frames (no re-branching). Each file carries a bake_note. t3_light audited and kept as shipped. All other clips and banks untouched; Roger bank is the control and is unchanged.

t3_light.raw_rejected: legs invert for 6 frames (feet above hips +1.0 m); the shipped low segment is a genuine deep-leaning palm thrust (stick-figure verified)

method: Skeleton-height measurement (Head world Y minus lowest bone world Y) in three rigs: (1) mannequin FK of the baked bank JSONs, (2) the game's own retargetT3Clips run offline in node on the real GLBs, (3) in-game via the roster harness (identity-gated, deterministic stepping). Controls: Roger bank on both rigs; in-browser bank swap (Megami served Roger bank data under the jun name via route interception).
question: Why does Megami render tiny/dark/crumpled when her TTT2 Jun bank (PRs #1558/#1561) plays, while Menajerii + Roger bank renders normal and unbanked Megami renders normal?
remaining_gaps: amju_kamae_test frames ~60-96 (the clip's traveling segment) stay low under every unwrap branch (best min 0.96 m mannequin FK); the stance is upright in game but this segment is the same non-upright-start family already awaiting the owner's normalization ruling (TTT2-BANKS handoff follow-up).
t3_walk_back's final frames fold under every branch (shared bank-2 clip ygco_bwalk00; the Roger bank's shipped copy of the same clip has the same property and is untouched by this PR).

Asuka's najn_jn2kam (the Jun-family production kamae named in her sKAM record) could not be substituted: her bank-1 table is not yet pinpointed (two candidate tables tie on shared-clip fingerprints and neither is confirmable as hers). Future option, not shipped.
Recommended follow-up (not in this PR): the bake gate should gain an anatomical-coherence check (feet-inversion / span profile over the whole clip) so future banks catch this fold class at bake time.
root_cause: The shipped Jun bank clips were baked through tools/anim/ttt2_bank_bake.py's euler unwrap re-branching into pose_synth's half-angle convention (game local = ZXY euler of the stored triple / 2), where adding +/-2pi to a stored component changes the posed rotation by pi. Which representative chain (forward vs backward anchored) a clip got was decided by the bake's plausibility gate, which checks only upright start, floor contact and relative joint jumps - it is blind to mid-clip pose folds. For the Jun-family clips the shipped chains fold: the stance tail collapses, the grab rides folded, the medium sags for its whole back half. Roger-bank clips sit in a branch-stable region of the same pipeline, which is why Menajerii was unaffected.
